items.name: core
items.title: Audio core
items.description: Framework-neutral audio primitives plus the Solid compatibility helpers used by the installable components.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Solid button primitive using the same base-rhea styling as the site.

items.name: use-frame-source
items.title: useFrameSource
items.description: Subscribe to a frame source with automatic Solid lifecycle cleanup.

items.name: use-clip-hold
items.title: useClipHold
items.description: Clip detection with hold time, count, and reset.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: Tracks the operating system reduced-motion preference.

items.name: use-visibility
items.title: useVisibility
items.description: Tracks whether an element intersects the viewport.

items.name: use-demo-signal
items.title: useDemoSignal
items.description: Synthetic speech, music, tone, or noise frame sources for demos and tests.

items.name: use-audio-context
items.title: useAudioContext
items.description: A shared AudioContext with a provider for supplying an existing context.

items.name: use-audio-analyser
items.title: useAudioAnalyser
items.description: Meter and visual frame sources backed by Web Audio AnalyserNode.

items.name: use-microphone
items.title: useMicrophone
items.description: Open a microphone MediaStream with browser processing disabled by default.

items.name: use-audio-config
items.title: useAudioConfig
items.description: Shared meter and control configuration context.

items.name: db-scale
items.title: dB Scale
items.description: Tick marks and labels for a decibel range.

items.name: db-readout
items.title: dB Readout
items.description: A stable-width numeric level readout.

items.name: clip-indicator
items.title: Clip Indicator
items.description: A clip light with hold, count, and reset behavior.

items.name: level-meter
items.title: Level Meter
items.description: Composable peak and RMS level meter with stereo, hold, scale, readout, and clip indication.

items.name: fader
items.title: Fader
items.description: A composable decibel fader with tapering, detents, keyboard stepping, reset, editable values, and optional wheel control.

items.name: parameter-slider
items.title: Parameter Slider
items.description: A labelled parameter slider with a numeric input, units, marks, reset, linear or log scaling, and unit scrubbing.

items.name: knob
items.title: Knob
items.description: A composable rotary parameter control with linear or circular dragging, keyboard and wheel input, editable values, scales, metal caps, and optional detent clicks.

items.name: pan-control
items.title: Pan Control
items.description: A left/right pan slider with a center fill, center detent, keyboard controls, accessible pan text, and double-click reset.

items.name: channel-toggle
items.title: Channel Toggle
items.description: Audio channel toggle buttons with neutral, mute, solo, and monitor tones plus inherited disabled state.

items.name: volume-control
items.title: Volume Control
items.description: A composable volume control with mute restore, perceptual or linear curves, horizontal and vertical sliders, and accessible level text.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact status badge with default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, and link variants.

items.name: channel-strip
items.title: Channel Strip
items.description: A composable horizontal or console-style channel strip with shared audio config, status parts, responsive layout, and clipping reflection.

items.name: mixer
items.title: Mixer
items.description: A horizontal or console-style mixer layout with shared audio configuration, empty state, master area, and keyboard focus navigation between channel controls.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Accessible popover with focus restoration and outside dismissal.

items.name: bar-visualizer
items.title: Bar Visualizer
items.description: Frequency-band bars with idle, loading and mirrored modes.

items.name: smooth-waveform
items.title: Smooth Waveform
items.description: A smooth frequency-band wave or oscilloscope trace.

items.name: live-waveform
items.title: Live Waveform
items.description: Live signal canvas with scrolling history, bars, mirrors and lines.

items.name: electric
items.title: Electric drawing
items.description: Shared electric canvas colors, sparks and geometry.

items.name: electric-bar-visualizer
items.title: Electric Bar Visualizer
items.description: Frequency-band bars drawn as crackling filaments.

items.name: electric-waveform
items.title: Electric Waveform
items.description: An electric wave or oscilloscope trace with forks and sparks.

items.name: spectrum
items.title: Spectrum
items.description: A frequency spectrum analyser with axes, grid and peak hold.

items.name: waveform
items.title: Waveform
items.description: A clip waveform with seeking, hover, regions and markers.

items.name: track-list
items.title: Track List
items.description: Track rows with active, playing and disabled states.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Keyboard shortcut
items.description: Keyboard shortcut labels and groups.

items.name: sound-pad
items.title: Sound Pad
items.description: Sound triggers with modes, hotkeys and progress.

items.name: use-audio-player
items.title: useAudioPlayer
items.description: Owned media playback with reactive controls and smooth time frames.

items.name: use-sound
items.title: useSound
items.description: Cached decoding and low-latency short sound playback.

items.name: use-waveform-data
items.title: useWaveformData
items.description: Decode files or audio buffers into cached waveform peaks.

items.name: use-web-audio-mixer
items.title: useWebAudioMixer
items.description: Mixer graph with gain, pan, monitoring, limiting and ducking.

items.name: use-level
items.title: useLevel
items.description: Samples a meter source for reactive level labels.

items.name: use-gain-node
items.title: useGainNode
items.description: Stable gain routing with click-free changes and connection cleanup.

items.name: use-audio-devices
items.title: useAudioDevices
items.description: Audio devices and permission state with live updates.

items.name: use-system-audio
items.title: useSystemAudio
items.description: Capture system or tab audio with cancellation and track cleanup.

items.name: use-mixer
items.title: useMixer
items.description: Mixer state controller for channel gain, mute, solo, pan, monitoring, master controls, audibility, dynamic channels, reset, controlled state, and optional localStorage persistence.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Accessible selection with Kobalte keyboard navigation.

items.name: audio-device-select
items.title: Audio Device Select
items.description: Audio device picker with permission, loading and disconnected states.

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: Composable transport, seeking, time, volume, rate and loop controls.
